title: /data page: closing a record opened from page 3 returns to page 1, because the page number is not in the address
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oK4fFfnLADcipbEeT

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding owed by the L1 REWORK of PR #36283 (#35875, comment 7074529092). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

Since PR #36283, a name click on the bare data page (`/data`) opens the record's full page with `from` set to the data page's URL, as #35854's rule asks. The data page keeps no page number in its address, so on a list showing page 3, opening a record and pressing ✕ lands on page 1, while the full page's ↑ ↓ still step through page 3's rows. Before #36283 the drawer opened over the list and the page was kept.

Read from code (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.tsx`), not yet measured on a running page.

## To do

- Keep the data page's current page in its address (or in the `from` origin the full page returns to), so ✕ returns to the page the reader left.
- Pin: open a record from page 3, close, land on page 3.

## Acceptance

- On `/data`, open a record from page 3 and close it: the list shows page 3.

Reader: area:ux (`domain:ui`), `ui/packages/app-shell`.

Dedupe: `data page page number close returns first page` (objectstack, open) → to be read by triage.
